title: P1 enqueue: response
description: TaskRef{id, existing}: existing: true means that the key already existed for the same initiator with the same body and the existing task is returned (IDM-1). A denial is problem details with a reason from the registry; a permission denial carries needs, a ceiling denial retry_after_s. idempotency_conflict comes without an id. The branch with reason in the success body is deprecated: in the HTTP v1 binding an enqueue denial always comes as problem details with status 422 (spec/bindings/http/README.md); the branch remains until 1.0 only for form compatibility. Since v0.2 a dry run (mode: validate) that passes answers with reason dry_run and the validate block, without an id; a dry run that is refused answers exactly as a real enqueue (PRM-11).

needs.description: Permissions that were missing; code fills it.

validate.description: Since v0.2: the answer of a dry run to the calling principal, never to the model (PRM-11).

type.description: Task type that the body resolves to.

max_tier.description: Highest tier of the task type.

reason.description: Reason when the decision is needs_approval.
